mapper.insert: insert into px_workspace_lock(owner_id) values(#{owner}) on duplicate key update owner_id=owner_id
mapper.select: select owner_id from px_workspace_lock where owner_id=#{owner} for update

choose.when: select id,owner_id,display_name title,mime content,'' rich_text,'' tags,revision from (select *,owner_id create_by from px_user_file) f where del_flag=0 and is_folder=false
select id,create_by owner_id,title,content,rich_text,'' tags,revision from px_note where del_flag=0
select id,create_by owner_id,title,content_text content,content_html rich_text,tags,fetch_status,0 revision from px_web_article where del_flag=0
select id,create_by owner_id,content title,remark content,'' rich_text,label tags,0 revision from px_to_do where 1=1
choose.otherwise: select null id,null owner_id,null title,null content,null rich_text,null tags,null revision where 1=0

mapper.select: select * from px_resource_tag where owner_id=#{owner} order by normalized_name,id
mapper.update: update px_resource_tag set name=#{name},normalized_name=#{normalizedName},parent_id=#{parentId},color=#{color},revision=revision+1 where id=#{id} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and revision=#{revision}
mapper.delete: delete from px_resource_tag where id=#{id} and owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.select: select tag_id from px_resource_tag_rel where owner_id=#{owner} and resource_type=#{type} and resource_id=#{id} order by tag_id
mapper.delete: delete from px_resource_tag_rel where owner_id=#{owner} and resource_type=#{type} and resource_id=#{id}
delete from px_resource_tag_rel where owner_id=#{owner} and tag_id=#{tagId}
mapper.select: select resource_type as type,resource_id as id from px_resource_tag_rel where owner_id=#{owner} and tag_id=#{tagId} order by resource_type,resource_id

choose.when: update px_web_article set tags=#{tags},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and create_by=#{owner} and del_flag=0
update px_to_do set label=#{tags},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and create_by=#{owner}
update px_user_file set update_time=update_time where id=#{id} and owner_id=#{owner}
choose.otherwise: update px_note set update_time=update_time where id=#{id} and create_by=#{owner}

mapper.select: and create_by=#{owner} and id > #{after} order by id limit 100
and create_by=#{owner} and id > #{after} order by id limit 100 for update
select last_id from px_resource_tag_backfill where owner_id=#{owner} and resource_type=#{type}
mapper.insert: insert into px_resource_tag_backfill(owner_id,resource_type,last_id,done) values(#{owner},#{type},#{after},#{done}) on duplicate key update last_id=#{after},done=#{done},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
